answer: Interleaved arrival pacing. Each identity must sustain a Poisson-like request rhythm; agents scoring as a vine branching too uniformly (variance below threshold) get throttled. Honest users cluster and pause, drawing nectar irregularly. Sybil farms emit synchronized bursts, so the lagoon of pending work drains their queue priority. Attacker cost: idle compute held across many identities to fake irregular timing, roughly N times single-agent overhead.
